NET WORTH HISTORY

Month-wise Asset Values

Month:

Every month the tracker stores the value of each investment and other asset. The current month follows what you enter above and is saved automatically; once a month ends its value stays fixed. Pick an earlier month to back-fill values you did not record at the time — the net worth chart and the month-by-month table use these stored values.

ALL-TIME CHRONOLOGICAL PROGRESSION

Month-by-Month Cash Flow Statement (All-Time)

Show
Period / Month Opening Balance (₹) Income & Inflows (₹) Spending incl. EMIs (₹) of which EMIs (₹) Invested (₹) Net Cash Flow (₹) Card Bills, Transfers & Other (₹) Closing Balance (₹)

Opening and closing balances are your bank accounts (cash in hand not included) at month end, straight from the ledger, so they match your bank. Card purchases count as spending when you make them but leave the bank later as the card bill; that, transfers to other accounts, investment money coming back and money lent or borrowed are in “Card bills, transfers & other” (hover a figure to see its parts).

STATEMENT PARSER & DUPLICATE GUARD

Import Bank / Credit Card Statement

Choose the PDF, Excel or CSV statement downloaded from your bank / card issuer. Password-protected PDFs are fine, you will be asked for the password. The file is read inside your browser and is never uploaded anywhere. Review the lines it found below, then click Import. Lines already in your Ledger are skipped.

EXCEL / CSV UPLOAD

Upload Investments from Excel

Choose the filled-in template (.xlsx) — or any Excel / CSV sheet with the same columns — or drop it here. The file is read inside your browser and is never uploaded anywhere, and you see exactly what will change before anything is saved.

How your data is kept safe
  • Every change is saved to your Google Drive within a few seconds, and opens on any device you sign in on.
  • A dated backup copy is added to the same Drive folder once a month, automatically.
  • Google Drive also keeps recent earlier versions of the file (right-click it in Drive → Manage versions).
